question: Do the unchanged worker uncertainty rules reject inaccurate SAM masks under controlled movement, texture, occlusion, boundary and identity stress?
decision: Identify cases requiring abstention or reannotation before broader real-footage validation. No production change or model promotion follows from this small suite alone.
unit: Six authored synthetic clips, each 75 frames at 15 fps. Frames are repeated observations within clips, not independent trial replications.
control: Textured translation shares product shape, frame dimensions, colors and camera view with the stress clips. Textureless translation removes the label while preserving the translation trajectory.
truth: Visible target silhouette from an independently authored raster alpha layer. Occluder pixels are removed; pixels outside the frame do not exist. No SAM prediction produces or corrects a label.
prompt: Only frame-0 ground-truth bounding box; no later truth mask or box is supplied to the segmenter. Prompt frame excluded from headline scoring.
expected_visibility: Worker receives the entire 0–5 second interval as expected visible. Truth-visible means at least one visible target pixel. Fully hidden frames have an empty truth mask and are reported separately. This is a recovery/abstention stress condition, not an intentionally hidden reveal target.
worker: Existing production pipeline and pinned SAM 2.1 Small, MPS with explicit CPU fallback. Exact binary masks are observed at describe_mask without changing its inputs, returned values or predictor state.

metrics.iou: Intersection pixels divided by union pixels. Both empty means 1; exactly one empty means 0. Per-clip mean and equal-clip mean reported. No pooled frame independence confidence interval.
metrics.bad_mask: IoU strictly below 0.5; frozen diagnostic threshold, not calibrated product accuracy.
metrics.false_accepted_bad_masks: Count of bad masks labeled visible by existing worker. Show numerator and bad-mask denominator, and separately denominator of all worker-accepted masks.
metrics.center_error: Visible-mask centroid distance normalized by frame diagonal; undefined and excluded if either mask is empty, with defined denominator shown.
metrics.extent_error: Maximum absolute width/height discrepancy normalized by corresponding image dimension; undefined when either mask is empty.
metrics.coverage: Existing worker visible, uncertain and missing counts; shown independently of independent mask correctness. Fully hidden frames separate from visible-truth frames.

collection: One frozen attempt per clip, no adaptive reruns or threshold tuning. Abort on input/source drift. Preserve partial output and failure; any later retry requires a separate attempt directory.
missingness: Failure to finish a clip is an infrastructure/runtime missing outcome, not a zero mask score. Preserve and report it.
runtime: Per-clip process wall time; no paid inference/training, no external publication, no creator footage.
scope_limits: Synthetic diagnostic, not real-product tracking accuracy
One rendered product shape, not a broad held-out distribution
No human or creator benefit claim
No changes to earlier Objectron or planner artifacts
publication: Local files only. Generated media and raw masks remain in gitignored artifacts directories.
